sentences.text: These add up independently, and these lower the risk: being a woman takes a typical patient's predicted risk from about 24% to about 1%; through this sum alone, compared with no chest pain symptoms, typical angina lowers it to about 2%, non-anginal chest pain to about 3% and atypical angina to about 14%, fasting blood sugar above 120 mg/dL lowers it to about 7%, and a higher maximum heart rate lowers it steadily, from about 27% at 118 to about 21% at 175 beats per minute; chest pain type, fasting blood sugar and maximum heart rate also act through the parts below.

parts.name: heart_disease_logit
parts.original_hypothesis: Root: p = sigmoid(z), z = 0.466 + LINEAR CORE - 1.077*fixed_defect_normal_sugar_gate - 0.899*no_asymptomatic_pain_indicator + 0.114*downsloping_st_indicator - 0.047*thalach_floor_relay. LINEAR CORE (19 direct input->output edges, z-scored inputs): ca +2.246, slope:2 +1.115, sex:1 +0.899, cp:3 -0.749, cp:1 -0.679, chol +0.671, trestbps +0.596, fbs:1 -0.583, sex:0 -0.559, thal:3 -0.541, oldpeak +0.491, cp:4 +0.308, exang:1 +0.282, slope:1 -0.238, thalach -0.125, fbs:0 -0.094, age +0.085, slope:3 +0.069, restecg:1 +0.062. Six inputs are unconnected (cp:2, restecg:0, restecg:2, exang:0, thal:4, thal:7; zero-effect entries of this root). thal:6 has no direct edge; it acts only through the fixed-defect gate. COMPOSITION: purely additive in the logit. Children: (1) fixed_defect_normal_sugar_gate, the one genuine interaction: an AND of fixed thallium defect and normal fasting sugar that lowers the logit by 3.92 for 10 patients; (2) no_asymptomatic_pain_indicator and (3) downsloping_st_indicator, binary ReLUs exactly affine on their one-hot inputs (re-parameterisations of the cp:4 and slope:3 linear terms; cp:4 total +1.47 logit, slope:3 total +0.57); (4) thalach_floor_relay, a near-inert hinge on max heart rate. The children share no hidden nodes; they are coupled only through inputs that also have direct edges (fbs:0, fbs:1, cp:4, slope:3, thalach). EVIDENCE (train, n=242): full model AUC 0.9423, acc 0.888 (compute_performance). Linear core alone (direct edges only) AUC 0.9328; logit SD 4.55 (core) vs 0.86 (all hidden readouts). Zero-ablating one child at a time: fixed-defect gate 0.9343, cp:4 indicator 0.9411, thalach relay 0.9416, slope:3 indicator 0.9421. Replacing all hidden readouts with one least-squares linear fit in their six inputs gives 0.9371; an L2 logistic regression on all 26 inputs gives 0.9355. Mean |SHAP| (train, all 242, probability scale): ca 0.172, slope:2 0.099, sex:1 0.069, cp:4 0.068, cp:3 0.056, thal:3 0.049, sex:0 0.042, chol 0.042. Interpretation: essentially logistic regression with one meaningful nonlinearity, the fixed-defect/normal-sugar gate, which cancels the core's over-prediction for that small group (10 patients). Counter-directional signs reported, not explained: fbs:1 -0.58 (high fasting sugar lowers the logit) and the gate itself making a fixed defect protective for normal-sugar patients. Same mechanism family as the 10-seed heart-s4 record (key 9650, gen 38): the same gate and linear core (ca +2.16 there), but here a cp:4 indicator and a slope:3 indicator replace that genome's cp:2 indicator, and the thalach relay feeds the output directly.

Hypothesis: a discrete AND detector that is on only for patients with a fixed thallium defect (thal 6) and fasting blood sugar <= 120 mg/dL, and then lowers their logit by 3.92, cancelling the linear core's over-calling of this group (thal:6 has no direct edge; the core gives these patients a mean predicted probability of 0.83 while their disease rate is 50%). EVIDENCE (train, n=242): exact on-data reduction 2065 = 3.639*[thal:6=1 AND fbs=0] (fbs=1 drives the pre-activation to <= -6.39). Active for exactly the 10 patients in that group; disease rate 5/10. Zero-ablating it lowers train AUC 0.9423 -> 0.9343, the largest nonlinear effect; a linear refit in its three inputs recovers only to 0.937 (R2 0.69), because an AND cannot be written additively. Mean |sensitivity| fbs:0 0.065 > thal:6 0.037 > fbs:1 0.028 (small because the gate is off for 96%). Supported, but the correction rests on 10 training patients and may be partly noise-fitted. Same gate as the 10-seed heart-s4 record (gen 38), now also fed by fbs:0.

EVIDENCE (train, n=242): on for exactly the 134 patients without asymptomatic pain (value 0.947, logit -0.852); disease rate 22% when on vs 71% when off. A linear replacement in cp:4 reproduces it exactly (R2 1.00, AUC unchanged 0.9423); zero-ablation (which also removes cp:4's main effect) gives 0.9411.
